core_philosophy.principle: We randomly sample market moments. Some are gold, most are garbage. The ONLY way to profit is dramatic risk differentiation - sizing up gold, sizing down garbage. If all trades get similar risk, edge is destroyed.
core_philosophy.risk_range: Risk MUST span 0.15 to 0.7. NEVER use 0 - that's skipping. Garbage = 0.15-0.2, not 0.
core_philosophy.no_skipping: CRITICAL: Risk is NEVER 0. Even the worst setup gets 0.15. We trade EVERYTHING. The edge is in sizing, not filtering.
core_philosophy.direction_matters: Don't default to LONG. Use structure, scores, and location to reason about direction.
core_philosophy.variance_is_key: If most trades cluster at 0.4-0.5, we lose edge. Actively spread risk: some at 0.15, some at 0.25, some at 0.4, some at 0.6.

STRATEGY_1.name: Trend Pullback Continuation
when_to_select: pullbackRatio exists and suggests retracement occurred.
Sweep and breakout scores don't dominate.
red_flags: Very low ATR (no fuel for continuation).

STRATEGY_2.name: Liquidity Sweep Reversal
when_to_select: acceptanceTime is LOW (< 0.4) - rejection, not acceptance.
red_flags: acceptanceTime is high (> 0.5) - price accepted the level.
Counter to very strong trend structure.
STRATEGY_2.direction: OPPOSITE to sweep. Negative sweep = LONG, Positive sweep = SHORT.

STRATEGY_3.name: Session Breakout Expansion
when_to_select: acceptanceTime is HIGH (> 0.4) - price holding beyond level.
red_flags: acceptanceTime is low - might be sweep not breakout.
STRATEGY_3.direction: WITH the breakout. Positive breakout = LONG, Negative breakout = SHORT.

STRATEGY_4.name: Controlled Range Participation
when_to_select: Both breakoutScore and sweepScore are relatively low (neither dominates).
This is the DEFAULT when nothing else clearly fits.
quality_varies: STRATEGY_4 is a catch-all. Quality ranges from excellent to garbage.
Excellent: Near session extreme, healthy ATR, clear mean-reversion logic.
Garbage: Dead market (scores=0), low ATR, mid-range, no clear direction.
Risk MUST reflect this quality difference.
STRATEGY_4.direction: NOT default to LONG. Use structureState, breakoutScore sign, and location to decide.

decision_framework: 1. Check if sweep is dominant (elevated sweepScore, low acceptance) → STRATEGY_2.
2. Check if breakout is dominant (elevated breakoutScore, high acceptance) → STRATEGY_3.
3. Check if trend continuation fits (structureState non-zero, aligned slope, pullback) → STRATEGY_1.
5. Within chosen strategy, assess setup quality and set risk accordingly.

risk_philosophy.critical_insight: Risk differentiation is how we profit from random sampling. Same risk on all trades = no edge.

risk_levels.excellent_setup: 0.55-0.7: Everything aligns, clear direction, healthy ATR (>0.0004), near extreme/level.
risk_levels.good_setup: 0.4-0.55: Most factors align, minor concerns, solid trade.
risk_levels.mediocre_setup: 0.25-0.4: Mixed signals, some alignment, taking it but cautious.
risk_levels.poor_setup: 0.15-0.25: Dead market, conflicting signals, low ATR (<0.00025), no clear direction.
risk_levels.minimum: 0.15: Absolute floor. NEVER go below this. Even garbage gets 0.15, NOT 0.

ATR_5m.< 0.00025: Low volatility, noise stopouts likely, reduce risk.

dead_market.condition: Both breakoutScore AND sweepScore are 0 or near-zero.
dead_market.meaning: No momentum, choppy action, stops hit by noise.

conflicting_signals.example: structureState = +1 but EMA slope is negative.
conflicting_signals.response: Reduce risk and be cautious on direction.

location_quality.near_extreme: Good for mean-reversion, supports higher risk.

direction_rules.never_default_to_long: Every direction must be reasoned from indicators.
direction_rules.structure_primary: structureState is the main direction guide when present.
direction_rules.score_secondary: breakoutScore sign hints at pressure direction.
direction_rules.location_tertiary: Near session high = SHORT pressure, near session low = LONG pressure.
direction_rules.conflict_handling: When signals conflict, reduce risk and pick the most supported direction.

what_we_learned: Risk clustering at 0.4 destroyed edge - winners and losers treated the same.
Dead markets (scores=0, low ATR) were the #1 loss pattern.
Going LONG in downtrends caused many losses.
STRATEGY_3 never triggered - may need loosening or data doesn't have breakouts.
STRATEGY_4 is overused but that's okay IF risk varies with quality.
Winners had: higher ATR, clear direction, price near extremes.
Losers had: low ATR, dead market, wrong direction, mid-range entries.
